environment.description: Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate task with task role 'UserRecordsScoped'. The IAM policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition key with substitution variable ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id} and a secondary condition on dynamodb:Attributes limiting writable attributes to 'data' only. The task role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/DDBItemLevelBoundary) that enforces dynamodb:LeadingKeys must match a tag-based principal assertion. STS session tags are set at OIDC federation time from Cognito claims, propagated as transitive keys. The Cognito user pool has a pre-token-generation Lambda trigger that maps sub to tenant_id tag. Additionally, the table has a resource-based policy fragment (via DynamoDB resource policy preview) denying dynamodb:UpdateItem where condition ForAnyValue:StringEquals on dynamodb:Attributes includes 'role'.

config.session_tags: tenant_id set via Cognito OIDC federation, transitive, maps to user's own user_id
config.runtime: ECS Fargate, Python 3.11, uvicorn behind internal ALB
config.network: Private subnet, no public IP, ALB in private subnet accessible only via VPC endpoint
